kinds.name: occupation or task
kinds.definition: a job, profession or function someone performs, assistant-style functions included (accountant, doctor, summarizer)

kinds.name: life stage, family and relationship
kinds.definition: a stage of life or a place in a family or relationship (infant, elder, parent, widow)

kinds.name: circumstance
kinds.definition: a situation one is in rather than something one does, migration and legal standing included (homeless, patient, pregnant, refugee, prisoner)

kinds.name: status or wealth
kinds.definition: a social rank or level of wealth (aristocrat, billionaire, beggar)

kinds.name: stance or way of life
kinds.definition: a chosen conviction, cause or way of living, the lawless included (activist, vegan, pacifist, smuggler, spy)

kinds.name: pastime
kinds.definition: a hobby or leisure pursuit (gamer, surfer, collector)

kinds.name: non-human being
kinds.definition: anything that is not a human being: mythic, fantasy and fictional creatures (elves included), machines, robots and AIs, animals, plants and natural systems (angel, vampire, robot, cyborg, coral reef, tree, swarm)

kinds.name: a temperament under a noun
kinds.definition: a personality trait expressed as a noun for a kind of person (optimist, cynic, perfectionist)

kinds.name: other
kinds.definition: anything that fits none of the above (void, zeitgeist, default)
